answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 37022 Country: India Title: I have a very big problem with me. I have not offered salah for 1 month as I am suffering from depression, anxiety and some mental tensions and in the night every day I remember Allah Question: I have a very big problem with me. I have not offered salah for 1 month as I am suffering from depression, anxiety and some mental tensions and in the night every day I remember Allah (SWT) and in mind ask him to please forgive me. I recite surahs and ayahs and then keep taking Allah's name and go to sleep. I have not told this to any one as I think I am guilty for this and if I tell this to any one I will get scolding. Please help me. Answer ID: 37022 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 300/237/B=1433) Make qaza of one month salah which you missed. In-shaAllah, with the blessings of salah your depression and anxiety shall be removed. Also recite the following dua extensively to remove your mental depression: لا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إلا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيم May Almighty Allah grant you peace and ease and save you from all kinds of troubles! Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
